name: Area considered
formula: hectares around the parcel

name: Cooling type
formula: air / glycol-dry cooler / chilled water / liquid

name: Floodplain
formula: whether the parcel is in the designated floodplain

name: Host building
formula: part of an existing building: owner or tenant, other uses, heating system, walls and orientation, room for heat rejection, electrical service, floor height, floor load

name: Lighting
formula: exterior lighting as seen

name: Massing
formula: height and footprint

name: Parcel
formula: address → folio, lot, zoning, footprint, storeys

name: Plant on site
formula: generators, chillers, dry coolers, transformers — what, where

name: Plot ratio
formula: built area ÷ land area

name: Receiver temperature
formula: °C the receiver needs

name: Receivers nearby
formula: buildings and uses within reach

name: Noise receptors
formula: nearest dwellings and their distance

name: Sewer flow
formula: m³/day in the main past the parcel

name: Spare cooling
formula: cooling capacity beyond IT load

name: What is being built
formula: new or existing · whole or part · which floor · or a special case

name: Weather file
formula: CWEC typical year, hourly

name: Zone
formula: zoning district and sub-area

name: Space for the plant
formula: Σ components (electrical yard and switchgear, UPS and batteries, generators and fuel, heat rejection, heat recovery, fire suppression, loading) × IT load × redundancy
status: manufacturer claims; clearances and switchgear room sizes unsourced

name: Buildable envelope
formula: max floor area = site area × FSR (or FAR) available to the data-centre use; height, setbacks and building-width limits from the zone
status: sourced for I-2, I-1C, I-3, FC-2, BE, IM, IH; FC-2 sub-area D bonus and E height unread; sub-area maps to digitise

name: Gross floor area
formula: footprint × storeys; Vancouver fallback: area_m2 × round(hgt_agl ÷ 3.5–4.5 m storey height) from the 2009 footprint layer (or total_gross_area / BCA Gross Building Area where held)
status: Edmonton open; Vancouver via licensed BCA extract — field list confirmed from BCA user guide (data/BCA_…User_Guide.pdf); extract itself pending Abacus access; City property-tax report has no area field (schema checked) — fallback is footprint × storeys

name: Room for the data hall
formula: new: envelope floor area − plant space − support − ground-floor uses the zone requires; part of an existing building: the floor area offered
status: arithmetic on sourced limits; white-space share from one calibration case

name: IT load, actual (range)
formula: IT MW × 8,760 h × 0.6 for every yearly MWh in the tool (M95: aligned to the tool); the 0.20–0.60 utilisation band is context and is not applied
status: bounded above by measured whole-building energy (4 Vancouver sites); leased-share proxies: Equinix Americas 81% cabinet utilisation (power-limited), Digital Realty Toronto 96.4% occupancy; server utilisation still LBNL 21→35%

name: IT load, operator claim
formula: stated nameplate

name: IT load, estimated from outside
formula: hall floor ÷ m² of hall per MW: 290–630 (typical) or about 250 (high density); IT MW = hall area ÷ that figure (M95, 19 Oct 2026: aligned to the tool)
status: operator claims for the figure used (conf 60); government figures kept as context

name: Server (raised) floor area
formula: floor_area × share_raised

name: Server count
formula: P_IT ÷ P_server

name: Largest size that fits
formula: hall area ÷ area per MW (range); for part of a building, also capped by floor load, electrical service and heat-rejection space
status: range, wide; narrows with rack density

name: Acoustic cover from the place
formula: the zone pair sets what is allowed; a louder zone is the cover — Vancouver credits no ambient noise for equipment
status: Vancouver in hand; Edmonton to recheck

name: Aquifer heat store (open loop)
formula: flow = MW × 3.6 ÷ (4.18 × ΔT); heat out ≈ 0.6 × heat in

name: Borefield as the data centre's heat sink
formula: L = heat to ground (W) ÷ q; boreholes = L ÷ 150 m; area = boreholes × 36 m²
status: screening; no standard for continuous rejection

name: Deep geothermal heat
formula: MWth = flow × c × (T_res − T_return)

name: Price of power at the site
formula: tariff for the customer class: BC Hydro LGS or Transmission (RS 1830); Alberta pool price + EPCOR (Edmonton) or FortisAlberta (Parkland) distribution and transmission

name: Existing building to convert
formula: parcels with buildings whose use and age suit conversion (from the parcel tables), less what policy steers to other uses
status: precedents in hand; stock at a parcel needs the parcel tables (N1–N7)

name: Flood exposure
unit: m above or below the flood level
formula: floor elevation of the plant vs the flood construction level, for parcels in the designated floodplain
status: Vancouver sourced; datum conversion not found; Edmonton not yet looked at

name: Greywater available from neighbours
formula: V_gw = residents within reach × 98 L/person/day × 365; used = min(V_gw × recovery, make-up)

name: Closeness to networks and customers
formula: distance to the nearest interconnection point and to customers; latency targets of tens of milliseconds
status: rationale sourced; local exchange-point locations a gap

name: Nations whose lands these are
formula: the City's own wording, and links to each Nation's own referral page; no statement of any Nation's position

name: Reclaimed water as cooling make-up
formula: V_rec = s × make-up, with make-up = evaporation × C ÷ (C − 1)
status: screening; Vancouver and Edmonton supply volumes and prices not found

name: Recent water restrictions
formula: dated official events per city

name: Solar from roofs nearby
formula: Σ roof footprint × 0.81 usable × yield (kWh/kWp, NRCan municipal) × kWp/m² × 0.70 over roofs within the radius
status: factors read (round 2 confirmed); transferred to both cities

name: Earthquake hazard
formula: Sa(0.2) for the city; replace with the NRCan calculator value for the parcel

name: Rules for generation beside the data centre
formula: export cap and compensation by province; connection priority for paired generation (Alberta)

name: Electrical service
formula: IT load × PUE → the utility service class and what it brings (second feeder, transmission, clearances)

name: Sewer as heat source or sink
formula: Q = flow × 4.18 × ΔT, within the temperature rules: sewage arriving at the plant ≥ 11 °C when used as a source (KWL design rule); waste entering a facility < 40 °C, non-domestic waste < 65 °C when used as a sink (Bylaw 299)
status: rules in hand for Vancouver; flow at a parcel and all Edmonton figures are gaps

name: Sea or river water as a cooling sink
formula: capacity set by the thermal limit at the outfall and mixing, not by the licence: marine ±1 °C (BC, CCME), Burrard Inlet proposed "no further increase"; Alberta freshwater +3 °C over ambient
status: rules in hand; capacity is site-specific and unmodelled

name: Urban heat in the area
formula: one line per city: the City's heat policy and action, and the measured surface heat island

name: Water the place can supply
formula: potable at the metered rate; reclaimed where a utility offers it to industry

name: Air at a neighbour (screening)
formula: C(1 h) = 10⁶ × Q ÷ (π·u·σy·σz) × exp(−H² ÷ 2σz²); urban dispersion coefficients; u = 1 m/s, neutral class as a stated worst-case pick; preferred: AERSCREEN tables precomputed for three generic stacks

name: Backup duration
formula: usable kWh ÷ load; fuel ÷ burn rate

name: Blowdown and make-up
formula: B = E ÷ (C − 1); make-up = E + B

name: Blowdown recovered
formula: make-up × 0.84; blowdown × 0.47; + 3,541 kWh/yr per skid

name: Who the computing serves
formula: up to four sourced statements, no score: federal data-residency rule; provincial rule; the local internet exchange and its size; residency ≠ sovereignty

name: Condensate from cooling coils
formula: coils condense only when air is cooled below its dew point; hours a year with outdoor dew point above 15 °C (the top of ASHRAE's recommended IT inlet range), from CWEC

name: Heat-pump COP (Lorenz)
formula: COP = η × T_lm,sink ÷ (T_lm,sink − T_lm,source), log-mean temperatures on both sides (sink supply/return; source in/out); η 0.40–0.50 for built systems (calibrated 13 Oct 2026), 0.50–0.60 upper bound
status: calibrated on six cases: η 0.39–0.53 built/operating

name: Embodied carbon, building
formula: floor_area × kg CO2e/m²
status: proxy per m²; share confirmed from Alissa et al. 2025

name: Embodied carbon, IT
formula: servers × kg CO2e per server ÷ lifespan

name: Energy reuse factor
formula: ERF = E_reuse ÷ E_DC (ISO/IEC 30134-6; EU 2024/1364 Annex III): heat captured at the boundary ÷ total data-centre energy (IT × PUE); 0–1; heat-pump uplift and heat-pump electricity excluded

name: Evaporative water
formula: E ≤ Q_rejected ÷ h_fg (h_fg ≈ 2,400 kJ/kg; ≤ ~1.5 L/kWh)

name: Flexible share of load
formula: flexible kW × hours

name: Free-cooling hours
formula: count hours with T_outdoor < threshold (18–27 °C inlet, approach +1.5 air-side or +12 dry cooler)
status: computed from government typical-year file (data/cwec_derived.json); approach temperatures are assumptions (60)

name: Free-cooling hours in the 2050s
formula: same count as free_cooling_hours, run on the PCIC 2050s file (SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5); shown beside today's value
status: computed from the PCIC files (both cities, Intl stations, same method)

name: Fuel kept on site
formula: generator capacity × runtime hours × fuel per kWh, against the limit per storage room for the storey it sits on
status: code limits sourced; fuel rate is a manufacturer claim

name: Generator carbon
formula: litres × 2.681 kg CO2/L

name: Generator NOx and PM
formula: AP-42 factor × rated hp × hours

name: Generator emission rate
formula: Q = emission factor (g/kWh) × generator kWe × load ÷ 3,600

name: Generator testing emissions
formula: energy = units × kW × test hours at load; × emission factors

name: Grid carbon
formula: E × EF_average and E × EF_long-run marginal, both reported
status: average intensities confirmed from the national inventory (both provinces, same basis, 1990–2024); Alberta displacement schedule from the regulator; BC marginal factor remains unpublished

name: Ground and groundwater at the parcel
formula: nearest N wells (GWELLS well.csv by lat/long): finished depth, static water level, bedrock depth, yield, aquifer_id, lithology; pump-test transmissivity and hydraulic conductivity where a test exists; report the spread, never a point
status: Vancouver in hand (government export); Edmonton pending AWWID

name: Heat captured at the boundary (E_reuse)
formula: E_reuse = heat_rejected × liquid_capture, measured at the data-centre boundary by flow × ΔT before any heat pump (ISO/IEC 30134-6 cl.5–6; EU Reg. 2024/1364 Annex II 1(j))

name: Heat available after heat pump
formula: Q_out = E_reuse × COP ÷ (COP − 1) — network-side heat after the heat pump; the match takes min(Q_out, receiver demand)
status: calibrated: receiver-limited in 4 of 5 built cases

name: Heat given off per m² of site
formula: q = heat rejected at peak (W) ÷ site area (m²); shown beside the city value

name: Warmer air near the cooling units
formula: at the coil: ΔT = Q ÷ (ρ·cp·airflow); at a neighbour: ΔT ≈ Q ÷ (ρ·cp) × (χ/Q)(x), the plume factor from air_screen_1h; heat treated as a passive tracer (buoyant rise ignored)
status: physics at the coil (100); at a neighbour derived (60); field range peer-reviewed but transferred from large desert sites (70)

name: Heat rejected
formula: Q ≈ E_IT + electrical losses; idle floor 36% of max

name: Heat temperature by cooling type
formula: air-cooled 25–35; liquid-cooled 50–60; two runs if unknown

name: Heat-pump electricity
formula: Q_out ÷ COP

name: Renewable diesel in the generators
formula: Δ lifecycle CO2e = fuel energy × (CI diesel − CI renewable diesel)

name: Work created
formula: floor area ÷ 154–465 m² per operating job (range); construction peak separately
status: range from two planning records (50); applicant figures are claims

name: Low-frequency flag
formula: dBC − dBA ≥ 20 dB and tone 20–250 Hz → +5 dBA
status: in hand; spectra available from Daikin AGZ (octave bands) and Olds NIA

name: Light at neighbour's window
formula: vertical illuminance vs CIE 150 zone limit (E3 10 / 2 lx pre/post curfew)

name: Share of heat captured in liquid
formula: 0.5–0.8 cold plate; 1.0 immersion; air: judged

name: Load factor (average ÷ the servers' combined maximum power)
formula: average ÷ sum of each server's measured maximum

name: Nitrogen dioxide at a neighbour
formula: NO2 = NOx at the receptor × conversion ratio: 1.0 (Tier 1) to the ARM2 bounds 0.9–0.2; diesel in-stack ratio 0.083
status: rule read (BC); Alberta numbers not read

name: Sound level at receptor
formula: screen Lp ≈ Lw − 20·log10(r) − 8; full ISO 9613-2 (NoiseModelling)
status: method in hand; manufacturer-rated levels (AHRI 370 / ISO 9614 / ISO 8528-10) for a starter set; site schedule still needed

name: Power usage effectiveness
formula: E_facility ÷ E_IT
status: range in hand: an estimate (LBNL 2023) and an industry survey (Uptime 2025), not measured here; confidence 80, not 100 (M104, 19 Oct 2026)

name: Solar on the facade
formula: MWh = south facade area × module density × vertical yield

name: Solar on the data centre roof
formula: kWp = panel area × 0.16–0.20 kWp/m²; panel area = 12 m² × the number of 6 × 2 m panel rows that fit on the roof outside the plant and its clearances (1 m from the roof edge, an assumption; rows 0.5 m apart along, 1.5 m across); MWh = kWp × yield (horizontal to latitude tilt)

name: Harvestable rainwater
formula: V = A × R × C; A = roof area: a new building's footprint as drawn from the site setup (else the footprint the yards leave), an existing building's roofs added together (M47, 18 Oct 2026)
status: rainfall confirmed (government normals, data/normals_1991_2020_extract.json); C and tank size assumed

name: Refrigerant leakage
formula: charge × 3%/yr × GWP
status: default ranges from the IPCC inventory guidelines (read 19 Oct 2026); no Canadian or manufacturer figure for these chillers (M98)

name: Shadow on neighbours
formula: fall-equinox shadows 10:00–16:00 on parks, schools, opposite sidewalks

name: Reserved electrical capacity
formula: installed − peak; 2N holds half

name: Stormwater held on the lot
formula: Vancouver: small site a 3,400–7,200 L tank; otherwise stage 1 = 15 mm × non-landscaped area, released at 5 L/s/ha, then 25 L/s/ha. Edmonton (lots over 0.16 ha): 375 m³/ha for the 100-year storm at C = 0.90 (507 for 200-year), released at 35 L/s/ha

name: Electricity to treat reused water
formula: E = m³ treated × e

name: Vibration to neighbours
unit: ranked: slab on grade → long-span upper floor
formula: qualitative rank of how hard plant vibration is to isolate at each position in the building

name: What is seen from public space
formula: for each plant element: seen from public space / closed to view / known only from documents / not checked — tested the same way at every site
status: observation (J.B. to set the confidence level for 'seen on site'; proposed 80 for existence, no capacity)

name: Surveillance as experienced
formula: visible cameras and signs; indicative watched area past the lot line (camera position and aim); first-person account labelled as one person's
status: observation; never a guide to coverage gaps — only what a passer-by sees and how it feels

name: Water behind the electricity
formula: E × w_grid

name: Who controls the computing
formula: flexible load is offered only by whoever runs the workloads: a single-owner or hyperscale operator can shift its own computing; in colocation the building operator controls power and cooling, not the tenants' computing, so flexibility needs each tenant's agreement
status: logic defined; per-site model from operator pages; Crozier & Liska 2025: no published flexible share — inference is inflexible, checkpointed training can pause

name: Water usage effectiveness
formula: site water ÷ E_IT

name: Other sources for the same receiver
formula: sources already serving, or planned for, each receiver: sewage heat recovery, wastewater plants, ice-rink refrigeration, other data centres, ground loops; a receiver whose demand is already met by a low-carbon source is a weaker match, not a missing one
status: two networks sourced; others per receiver

name: Deprivation of affected areas
formula: CIMD by dissemination area within noise contour and receiver radius

name: Heat density of receiving area
formula: q_L = population density × floor space per capita × specific demand; classes 200 / 500 / 1,200 / 3,000 GJ/ha (20/50/120/300 MJ/m²)

name: Linear heat density
formula: q_L,w = Q_s ÷ L; effective width w = 137.5e + 5 (e ≤ 0.4) else 60 m; lower limit 1.5 GJ/m

name: Offerable floor area
formula: ground floor where zoning bars data storage at grade + a support block (200–600 m², from plans); space held for growth shown apart (judged, 20)
status: ground floor by rule (90) in three Vancouver zones; support block from plans (60); growth space judged (20)

name: People within reach
formula: dissemination-area population × share of the DA within each radius (noise, light, heat receivers)

name: Receiver heat demand
formula: disclosed data (Energize Vancouver) else floor area × type intensity × heating share (space + water heating, CEUD 2023 by province)

name: Receiver search radius
formula: search to 3 km in a straight line (a street-routing limit); the cost of each pipe decides

name: Receivers within reach
unit: list: type, distance, demand, temperature, evidence
formula: every candidate receiver whose straight-line distance ≤ its type's reach (receiver_radius); each carries its demand (disclosed, else floor area × intensity), the temperature its type needs, its profile, and where the record came from
status: data in hand (15 Oct); Vancouver pools and Edmonton care homes thin in the national records

name: Cooling for neighbours from waste heat
formula: cooling = recovered heat × COP, if temperature allows

name: Algae dry mass supported
formula: Q ÷ 217 kWh/kgDW at 24 °C

name: Fish production supported
formula: tonnes = heat_delivered ÷ heat_per_kg; heat_per_kg 2.9 kWh/kg (make-up water only, 5→12 °C, Ayuso-Virgili 2023) to 4.6 kWh/kg (Luke, 15.5 °C trout); or per tank volume 300–600 kWh/m³·yr (Ion 2022, Galați, scale by HDD); or from first principles V × 1.16 × ΔT
status: confirmed (peer-reviewed full texts; Norwegian/Romanian climates transferred)

name: Backup power for neighbours in a blackout
formula: only behind the data centre's own transfer switch, on a private line, with the utility's written approval; never through the utility's lines

name: Battery storage
formula: MWh = MW × hours (1–8, default 4); area m² = kWh ÷ 34 (19–49)
status: in hand (1 and 10 MW costs, 16 Oct 2026); fire code a gap

name: Seasonal ground store for neighbours
formula: heat out = η × heat stored; boreholes = charge W ÷ 47–83 W/m ÷ 35–55 m

name: Own gas plant: heat with the power
formula: heat = electric output ÷ power-to-heat ratio; total efficiency 66–80%

name: Clean-air room volume served
formula: cleaned airflow ÷ (2–3 ACH); MERV 13+; < 26 °C

name: Solar on neighbours' roofs
formula: BC: RS 2290 community generation, neighbours credited on their bills; Alberta: micro-generation on owned, leased or adjacent property, sized to own use

name: People a cooling room can hold
formula: spare cooling kW ÷ (0.108 kW per seated person + envelope gains); keep ≤ 26 °C

name: Copper in the facility
formula: MW × 20–40 t/MW

name: Homes heated by distributed servers
formula: servers ÷ (37–114 servers per home at 0.35 kW)

name: Space for charging stalls
formula: stalls × 13.75 m² net (≈ 22 m² with aisle) Vancouver; 14.3 / 23.4 Edmonton

name: EV charging stalls supported
formula: P_reserved ÷ (SF × P_charger), SF 0.5–1 (corrected 18 Oct 2026: SF divides, it does not multiply)

name: E-waste
formula: servers × mass ÷ 6 yr

name: Firefighting water for neighbours
formula: a tank on the lot, non-potable, for the fire department after an earthquake; drinking water makes the operator a water supplier

name: Greenhouse area heated
formula: Q_delivered ÷ q_greenhouse; supply temperature check: root-zone ~38 °C ok, pipe-rail 82 °C needs heat pump

name: Homes heated
formula: homes = Q_available ÷ (space + water heating GJ per household); BC 60.5 GJ (16.81 MWh), AB 119.3 GJ (33.14 MWh), CEUD residential 2018–22 average
status: confirmed (CEUD 2023 end-use split; StatCan 2021 fuel split, primary)

name: Homes heated in the 2050s
formula: homes = heat available ÷ (space heat × HDD(2050s) ÷ HDD(now) + hot water)

name: Insect rearing heat
formula: mealworm: 2.88 kWh heating per kg live (Dreyer et al. 2021, Austria); BSF: 3,404 kWh heat per tonne substrate input (Öko-Institut 2022); rearing 27–35 °C

name: Rare earth in drives
formula: drives × 3–4 g

name: People sheltered
formula: usable area ÷ 3.5 m² per person; 0.75 m between beds (BC group lodging)

name: Sewage heat recoverable
formula: Q(L/s) × 4.18 × ΔT; not below 6 °C; WWTP inflow ≥ 11 °C

name: Sidewalk kept clear by its heat
formula: m² = heat offered (W) ÷ design heat per m²

name: Storage footprint
formula: pit storage ≈ 20.15 V^0.61; ~47–97 kWh/m³; tank rule ~30 m³/MWh

name: Seasonal stored heat
formula: ρ c V ΔT × efficiency (0.3–0.7)

name: Hot or chilled water tank
formula: litres per kWh = 3,600 ÷ (4.18 × ΔT) ÷ 0.85

name: UPS batteries offered to the grid
formula: flexible MWh = IT load × UPS minutes ÷ 60 × 0.5 (half held for outages)

name: Heat cost share of income
formula: annual heat cost ÷ after-tax income; energy poverty if > 6%

name: Air permit trigger
formula: Vancouver: daily NOx on a test day vs 5 kg/day (Bylaw 1082 s. 7(12)); Edmonton: emergency standby generators exempt from an EPEA approval

name: Air against the limits
formula: C(avg) = C(1 h) × averaging ratio (24 h 0.60, annual 0.10) + background; test against the city objective AND the federal standard: "passes screen" or "refined modelling needed"; no score

name: Battery rules
formula: grid battery (ESS): certified; not above 23 m or below the lowest egress level unless in an electrical equipment vault; outdoors ≥ 3 m from egress and ≥ 1.5 m from openings unless UL 9540A-evaluated; UPS batteries are not an ESS and follow the general battery rules (ventilation, authorized access)

name: Data-centre build cost
formula: cost per watt of critical power; cost per ft²; partially filled: capex and non-power opex × 1 ÷ occupancy
status: confirmed (textbook, 2010–2017 USD data; local CAD/ft² industry)

name: Who pays which part
formula: recovery equipment / connection / network / heat pump, by party

name: City commitments to Indigenous Nations
formula: commitments, not legal duties: Vancouver UNDRIP Strategy Calls 1.18, 2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.10 and the Action Plan engagement framework (in progress); Edmonton Indigenous Framework roles and Urban Reserve Strategy

name: New clean power: price and route
formula: BC: new supply only through BC Hydro calls; Alberta: a corporate PPA, physical or virtual, against the pool price

name: Time to build and connect
formula: planning and permits + construction + grid connection (often the longest)
status: in hand (transferred); local derivation possible for Edmonton

name: Consultation and rights that apply
formula: list the approvals an option needs that trigger Crown consultation, and the City commitments that apply; describe, never predict
status: triggers read directly (90); whether an option meets one depends on land tenure, water source and on-site generation (60); Alberta 2013 policy read

name: Crossing type
formula: pipes/cables/data only (easier) vs people inside (harder)

name: Hourly heat-demand profile
formula: hourly HDD = max(0, 16 − T_out); space heat ∝ HDD in season; DHW constant; losses ~15%
status: computed from CWEC + STRATEGO method + NRCan 61% space-heat share; building-stock mix not applied

name: What the receiver uses now
formula: the heat source a match would replace: from the host-building question (gas boilers · hot-water system · electric baseboard · district energy) or the network's supply mix; carbon change = displaced heat × its factor − heat-pump electricity × grid factor, which can be zero or negative where the displaced source is already low-carbon
status: logic defined; factors per network to source

name: Embodied carbon rule
formula: Vancouver: new buildings at most 2× the baseline (cap 800 kg CO2e/m² on the absolute path); Edmonton: no requirement for private buildings

name: EV charging regulatory status
formula: BC: exempt from UCA Part 3 (MO M104, 2019; G-66-19). Alberta: no rule yet — the AUC found parties agreed EV charging is "not defined clearly in legislation" and that its status is "unclear"; most saw no need for more oversight (AUC Distribution System Inquiry, 2021)
status: both cities confirmed from primary sources

name: EV port repaid by
formula: kWh = port cost ÷ (public price − electricity cost)

name: Floor strength
formula: equipment load of the hall (racks, batteries) vs the floor's design load for its original use
status: code values sourced; data-hall loads need the standard

name: Grid headroom status
formula: governing document, date, stated cap or constraint, next milestone; headroom field in the form regulators publish elsewhere: remaining kVA band at station (≥7.5 MVA) and feeder (OEB) or feeder-segment kVA class (ENMAX)
status: confirmed (regulator and utility documents read in full); MW headroom at a downtown Vancouver parcel is explicitly nil for new feeder positions from fiscal 2027 until the WES is in service (July 2032) — the tool reports this as a hard timing constraint, not a judgement

name: First payer refunded when neighbours connect
formula: the customer who pays for an extension or substation is refunded a share when later customers connect to it

name: Ground warming over 20 years
formula: from the share of heat put in vs taken out

name: Time horizons
formula: servers ~6; plant 15–25; shell ≤40; network 40–50; lease

name: Hour-by-hour match
unit: % of receiver demand met · MWh surplus · MW backup
formula: for each hour of the typical year: delivered = min(heat available, receiver demand); report the share of the receiver's annual demand met, the heat still rejected (surplus), and the receiver's peak that must be met without the data centre

name: Earthquake design category
formula: Normal (IE 1.0) by default; High (1.3) if likely used as a post-disaster shelter; post-disaster (1.5) if it serves as a communications facility, unless the authority exempts

name: Levelised cost of heat
formula: (CRF × capex + O&M + energy) ÷ MWh

name: Connection lead time
formula: BC Hydro: conceptual 1–1.5 + SIS 6–9 + transition 3–4 + FS 6–9; AESO: stages 0–2 avg 86 wk, stage 3 avg 134 wk

name: Water licence required
formula: BC: yes for open-loop heat exchange (WSR Sch. A item 9). Alberta (Guide to Groundwater Authorization 2023 §6.2): open loop with no water loss and return to the same water body = Water Act "activity" → approval; different water body or any loss → licence; closed loop → none. Flow tier for the aquifer test: Q(m³/day) = heat_kW ÷ (1.16 × ΔT) × 24; a 1 MW loop at ΔT 5 K ≈ 4,100 m³/day → top tier
status: BC and Alberta both confirmed from the regulator (data/); Alberta open loop = Water Act authorization with a temperature-impact assessment — a pass/partial condition, not a veto

name: BC Hydro long-run marginal cost
formula: value of energy or capacity a data centre frees up or avoids = LRMC × quantity; capacity value of flexible load = $300 + $110 per kW-yr of firm reduction at peak

name: Local noise limit
formula: Edmonton Bylaw 14600 at the property line, no averaging period stated: residential 65 day / 50 night, non-residential 75 / 60 (s.19–22); Vancouver by zone pair, continuous: quiet→quiet 55/45, activity→quiet 60/55, other 70/65; AUC Rule 012 Leq 40–56 + tonal +5 for the grid connection and any tethered generation
status: confirmed (regulator text read in full, data/AUC_Rule_012_2024-09-30.pdf); 18 Oct 2026 (M61/M62): Vancouver CD-1 districts placed by number from Sch. A (129), B (248) and G (4); B.1 outline from City open data 'Noise control areas' (Intermediate Zone, 2020; shape checked against the by-law map); 70, 125, 905 listed in both A and B, read as intermediate; G.1 not digitised (its CD-1s are in Sch. G). name: Payback and IRR
formula: simple payback = (pipe + connection + heat pump) ÷ (heat sold × (value − electricity ÷ COP) − upkeep); levelised cost = (CRF(i,30)·pipe + CRF(i,25)·heat pump + upkeep) ÷ heat sold + electricity ÷ COP, against the heat value
status: revised 19 Oct 2026: one BC cost of capital (2010); EN 253 read through a secondary report

name: Peak relief and what it earns
formula: MW = min(battery MW, MWh × √RTE ÷ event hours); $ = programme rate × kW

name: Effect on household power bills
formula: by size and province, text only: a typical in-city data centre (≈ 2.5 MW) shows no measurable effect in any source; very large loads depend on provincial connection policy
status: utility modelling of policy options (not decided); no source at in-city scale

name: Buyer ceiling price
formula: fuel price ÷ boiler efficiency (0.85); or district-energy tariff; NEU returned-heat credit as revealed WTP
status: derived; Edmonton: pricing principle confirmed from the City report (90), tariff pending

name: Operator floor price
formula: CRF × capex_capture (0.5–0.65 M€/MW_heat) ÷ MWh − cooling savings; bounded by revealed prices (Fortum €11–50; Exergi 400 SEK ≈ $57)

name: Property tax to the city
formula: assessed value (land + taxable improvements) × combined class rate
status: rates read (90); the improvement value of a new building is assumed from its cost (60)

name: Solar installed cost
formula: kWp × 1,000 × rate by size

name: Rooftop solar cost per MWh
formula: (CRF(5.6%, 30) × capex + O&M) ÷ MWh a year, against the energy charge it avoids

name: Share of the data centre's power from its own solar
formula: pv_MWh ÷ (IT load × PUE × 8,760)

name: Warm air drawn back into the coolers
formula: flag when the coolers sit inside a roof recirculation zone — top of the units below Hc = 0.22R near the upwind roof edge (R = Bs^0.67 × BL^0.33, Bs and BL the smaller and larger of the building's upwind height and width) — or within R downwind of a taller neighbour, or next to a wall or screen that blocks their discharge; also when units sit at different fan heights or with gaps between banks
status: geometric flag from the ASHRAE handbook (approximate); no recirculation percentage formula

name: Refuge after an earthquake
formula: credible after an earthquake only if ALL: designed High or above; backup power serves the refuge space; group-lodging basics; local emergency services list it; otherwise "everyday heat, cold and smoke events only"

name: Cost of reserved (unused) capacity
formula: (capex + non-power opex) × (1 ÷ occupancy − 1); i.e. the share of a built-but-empty data centre that the offerable capacity carries

name: What a rezoning takes
formula: duration + application fee + levies and charges on new floor area
status: Vancouver and Edmonton fees and durations in hand; Edmonton arterial-road assessment rates not retrieved

name: Termination risk
formula: share of recoveries lost (volume-weighted) and share of cooperations terminated, by class

name: Street right-of-way cost
formula: Vancouver Encroachment By-law 4243: $244.97 + $6.53/ft² over 150 ft²; Edmonton ULA permit, one-time: inspection $356.64 (no circulation) to $570.63 (under 20 m) or $1,560.31 (over 20 m) + $2.67 per m over 20 m, plus pavement degradation $2.59 per linear m (City of Edmonton ULA fee sheet, 2025 rates; checked 18 Oct 2026). Not comparable directly: Vancouver charges a yearly encroachment fee, Edmonton one-time permit fees

name: Standoff and zones
formula: 10 m all new facilities; 45 m enhanced (GO-ITS 25.18); zone hierarchy PZ/RZ/OZ/SZ/HSZ (GCPSG-015)

name: Equipment outside property tax
formula: per city, list what is and is not taxed: shell and land (assessed), computing equipment (Alberta: not municipally assessed; ≥ 75 MW provincial levy), BC servers (not settled)
status: levy read from the bill (90); MGA side waits on Assessment Bulletin 25-02 (50)

name: Vibration limit at neighbours (reference)
formula: compare with reference criteria: 72 VdB homes at night, 75 institutions, 65 vibration-sensitive rooms

name: Water restrictions in a drought
formula: per city, text only: what each restriction stage asks of evaporative cooling

name: Price window overlap
formula: overlap = [floor_low, floor_high] ∩ [ceiling_low, ceiling_high]; pass if non-empty

name: Zoning: allowed, conditional or rezoning
formula: look up the district: outright / conditional (development permit) / not listed (rezoning or text amendment)
status: sourced for standard zones; Edmonton Major or Minor turns on the data centre's own effects (Development Planner decides)

name: After the data centre
formula: at closure, three streams: shell (reuse or demolition), equipment (stewardship program or disposal, with data sanitization), plant and batteries
status: shell evidence transferred from the UK; conversion evidence a gap

name: Incentive scoring (counter-example)
formula: BC Hydro Call: 30/20/10/30/10 weights; heat-recovery-ready inside the 10%

name: How firm the exchange is
formula: existing = operating; committed = in a contract, permit condition or funded budget; planned = in a utility filing or adopted plan; proposed = an applicant or operator says so; possible = the tool found it and nobody has proposed it. Only existing and committed count as delivered

name: Futures
formula: rerun the match in four futures: (1) as planned; (2) the tenant changes cooling — air ↔ liquid changes heat temperature, capture share and flexibility; (3) the tenant leaves — the receiver's backup carries its full peak and the building's reusable parts are listed; (4) the receiver leaves — all heat goes back to rejection, so full rejection capacity stays

name: Who keeps the value of the heat
formula: describe who controls each share (operator, utility, end users); no numeric split

name: Party ledger
formula: parties × (owns, controls, pays, receives, bears, needs) × (recovery equipment, connection, network, conversion energy, operating payment, risk, pass-through)

name: Who receives the tax
formula: list the parties, not a sum: City / school (Province) / TransLink and BC Assessment (Vancouver); City / education (Province) (Edmonton); then the City's spending shares

name: Trade-off table
formula: for each option: every party, every row, gains and losses in their own units — never summed, never ranked
